::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
SMIC's founding fab (entity registered 21 December 2000, 张江路18号) — the 8-inch campus the tracker's SMIC coverage omitted while following the new mega-JVs. It remains the backbone of SMIC's 200mm base (~355,000 wafers/month group 8-inch across Shanghai/Tianjin/Shenzhen, running at ~96% utilization in 2025 Q3, with BCD prices raised ~10% from December 2025 as global 8-inch supply tightened).
:::

**Chinese name:** 中芯国际集成电路制造（上海）有限公司 (Zhōngxīn Shànghǎi (Zhāngjiāng))

## What does this facility make?

Mature-node 200mm logic, analog/power (BCD), and embedded-nonvolatile wafers.

## Why does it matter?

The 8-inch legacy fabs are where the 2025-26 mature-node price cycle actually bites — SMIC's >95% utilization on these lines, not the headline 28nm JVs, is the volume story of China's foundry expansion.
